      "evidence": "Modifies the public bitcoinkernel C/C++ API in src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.h and separates kernel logging from node logging infrastructure.",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Reduces node dependencies by decoupling the kernel from logging.cpp while replacing brittle string-based log parsing with structured callbacks for external consumers. This fulfills RFC #34062 and enables downstream work (#30342, #33847), directly serving libbitcoinkernel's core goal of establishing clean modular boundaries."
